title: Erosion dissolve: a patched standard material discarded below a scrolled noise threshold
intent: Dissolve the hero to change the subject
summary: One stock `MeshStandardMaterial` on a lathe-turned cone patched by `onBeforeCompile` at seven sites: three octaves of hashed 3D value noise in object space (frequency `2.6`, amplitude `±.14`) added to a 0–1 height along a world-space axis, `discard` below a front `uFront (−.295, 1.15)` mixed by `uProgress` (nothing discarded or charred at 0, nothing left at 1), an ash-grey feather of `.025` hashed in cells of `1/72` unit or one pixel, a hot core and an ember band `uEdge .03` that never thin below a pixel (`max(fwidth(d), 1e-5)`), charring over four band widths, and back faces shaded as a flat smouldering cut so the shell reads solid; one ScrollTrigger maps a `380svh` sticky stage to `uProgress` between `.12` and `.88` (ease none, Lenis on the GSAP ticker), the cone turns `.8 rad` (a mould seam shows it), an orange point light peaks at `6` on the dish half-way, and the renderer draws one frame per change, none while idle or off screen; reduced motion cuts each of three chapters to a still (`0 / .5 / 1`), the static tier shows the whole SVG still, and `?nogl`, no WebGL2 or a lost context show the same still (the camera's projection of the lathe) burnt along a wavy clip to the same row
variants: erosion from the tip down along world −y with an ember band (this)
a sideways exit: uAxis (1, 0, 0), the noise frequency halved, no ember (a cool edge colour instead)
a loaded glTF: the same patch on its stock material, uMin / uMax from its bounding box along the axis
R3F: onBeforeCompile on a memoised <meshStandardMaterial side={DoubleSide}>, uniforms in a ref, frameloop="demand" and invalidate() from the trigger
